lines.text: Israel is told not to rejoice like the nations, because they have played the harlot against their God.
Ephraim will not remain in the LORD's land but will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Moab.
Even if they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them and Memphis will bury them.
The LORD found Israel like grapes in the wilderness, but their fathers went to Baal-peor and became detestable.
The LORD says all Ephraim's evil appears at Bethel, and He will drive them from His house.
